name: Wren
summary: The first person the world answered. Every culture claims her, and each has its own name for her.

name: Oren Kel
summary: Teskari master who cast the Morning Bell and taught the Concord to make bells that carry across valleys.

name: Corvane
summary: Leader of the Imperative and author of the Iron Sentence. Nobody knows what became of him after the Silent Field.

name: Maudry Tull
summary: A retired shepherd who told stories at a cold hearthstone for a year and a day until it grew warm. Her rocking chair is still by the fire.

name: Velisa Corro
summary: Solanne navigator who bet a barrel of cider she could reach the farther edge of the Wide by sea. Her letters still arrive, each claiming she is winning.

name: Hjalla Osvik
summary: Eskeln trailblazer who took the other side of the Great Wager on foot, heading north. Her letters say the same thing Corro's do.

name: the Old Hearth
summary: The first hearthstone relit in the Rekindling, in the Lanternfold's square. Never cold, and always just warm enough to be disappointing.

name: the Unfinished Map
summary: The great wall map in the Lanternfold that every returning wayfarer adds to. It still has far more blank than ink.

name: the Morning Bell
summary: Oren Kel's great bell, heard in every valley of the Concord at once. Lost in the Quarrel; when it rings again, the whole Wide will hear.

name: the Iron Sentence
summary: Corvane's commanding glyph, meaning "you will." Broken into fragments after the Silent Field and scattered; some people still seek them.
